user.title: Gym Tracker
user.description: Guides you through your strength training exercise by exercise and charts your progress. The plan "Ganzkörper-Training" is created automatically.

init.title: Gym Tracker options
init.description:
Allowed users: empty = every user may use the panel. Every user only sees their own plans and workouts.

If shown: {plans} plan(s) and {sessions} session(s) from before version 0.3.0 are not assigned to a user yet. Choose their owner under "Assign existing data to". Only users without an own plan are offered.
